title: Non-Mewtonian Cat
author: Mohammed Saud
desc_full: Is that a solid? Is it a liquid? No! It’s a cat! Solve increasingly difficult puzzles as a non-mewtonian cat that defies laws of physics. Controls Move: W A S D or ↑ ← ↓ → Undo: Z Restart level: R Touch controls automatically enabled on supported devices. The game also supports controllers! Thank you for playing!
